title: A függetlenség kimondása (Declaring Independence)
grammar: Political Declarations, Subjunctive Demands & 1848 Narrative Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the Declaration of Independence declared in 1849.
I can use verbs such as kimond and szentesít to say what the king and the parliament did.
I can say where the government moved in early 1849.
I can use six new words about the April Laws and the Declaration of Independence.
